perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note advertises a proved Gaussian limit, feasible covariance, simultaneous ellipses, and matched risk, but every one of these results depends on the claimed uniform critical-control theorem. That theorem obtains its central frozen-pole, moving-pole, coefficient-stability, and mixed-remainder conclusions by citing lem:uniform-critical-estimates, whose proof compresses the decisive transformed-kernel comparison into an unsupported dyadic-annulus assertion and invokes the unproved, uncited lem:one-map-mixed-linearization. The opposite-fold pole rate and variable-coefficient resolvent bounds are likewise asserted without estimates strong enough to establish the stated uniform L2 conclusions. Consequently the delivered content is the torus identification, formal nested derivative structure, bandwidth arithmetic, and special separable or constant-coefficient checks—not the critical inference theory claimed in the TL;DR, project justification, interpretation, and honest-scope section. The missing analytic gate also invalidates the upper-risk half of the advertised matched rate and leaves no implemented Card–Krueger analysis or nonseparable numerical kill test to support practical significance. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 4.7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: cited-underspecified@lem:fixed-path-ma-linearization-source, positioning@thm:joint-critical-clt, positioning@thm:matched-critical-risk
